g.text: High-Performance 4K Native Windows Live TV Player
MorningTV is an ultra-low latency, native Windows desktop live television streaming system engineered for zero-buffering, sub-second
channel switching (<0.4s), and continuous broadcast continuity.

text.tspan: Legacy IPTV players (VLC, Kodi, Electron wrappers) face key issues: slow channel switching (2–5s), CDN/CORS blocking, ISP jitter & buffer
starvation, volume inconsistency, and ~15% stream decay every 48 hours.
